drop_reason: Keep every raw row; eligibility is a separate flag

segment_summaries.notes: Every summary is per snapshot. Price extremes are retained. Demand measures are proxies/estimates, not observed bookings. Segments with no primary supply have no primary median; see all_segments for full coverage.

rules.metadata: Added snapshot_date, source_file and row ordinal to all rows; no source values altered

steps.step: 1. Raw string ingestion and filename provenance

rules.mapping: empty source token -> missing except license; omitted host_verifications literal None -> missing; literal N/A licenses preserved

rules.counts: nullable integers; fractional units preserved in Float64 fields
rules.price: strip $ and commas only; no unit change or filling

steps.step: 4. Parse amounts, counts, ISO dates and nullable Booleans

rules.no_reviews: zero lifetime reviews; no rate imputation
rules.suspicious_values: Preserved unchanged; no flags delete or cap rows

steps.step: 5. Flag suspicious values and classify stay cohorts

rules.normalization: Uppercase recognized full-match identifiers only; all others null in separate normalized field
rules.status: Format classification does not establish registry validity

rules.demand: short & city scrape & not possibly inactive; price not required
rules.pricing: short & priced & city scrape; medians include extremes

steps.step: 7. Separate pricing and demand eligibility; retain all rows
